|lore=Military advisor to Mon Mothma. Leader of commando project. Corellian native. Defected to the Alliance shortly after the Battle of Yavin. Rescued by Rogue Squadron.
|game_text=Scout. Once during your deploy phase, if present at a battleground, may take a scout of ability &lt; 3 (or any [Endor] scout) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle here or at same system as Ackbar, if you just played Critical Error Revealed, may retrieve 1 Force.

* '''PC-E1''' ([[General Crix Madine (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). Once during your deploy phase, if present at a battleground, may take a scout of ability &lt; 3 (or any [Endor] scout) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle here or at same system as Ackbar, if you just played Critical Error Revealed, may retrieve 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[General Crix Madine (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•General Crix Madine”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[General Crix Madine (V)]] (published 26 December 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[General Crix Madine]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
